name: spinup_memory
description:
Initializes the centralized agent memory for a project — creates the memory directory, seeds project facts, and writes a starter strategy template.
Use when: starting a new project, onboarding a new agent to an existing project, or resetting a project's memory baseline.
Scope: local filesystem (~/.config/agentic-store/memory/). No network access.
Not for: restoring a prior session (use restore_session), writing individual facts (use memory_write), or reading current state (use restore_session).

project_name.description: Short name for the project. Example: 'agentic-store-mcp'.

stack.description: Tech stack summary. Example: 'Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL'.

reset.description: If true, clears existing facts and rewrites strategy. Default: false.
